verdict.rationale: Base44 explicitly documents 'Bring your own agent' functionality allowing users to connect their own AI coding agent (or scripts) to a Base44 app's sandbox, either with or without a local code copy, plus CLI/SDK access and MCP server integration for external assistants. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of bring-your-own-agent working in practice, and detail on how it interoperates with or replaces the built-in agent's UI/workflow.
